xna-type.name: Viewport
xna-type.summary: Defines the window dimensions of a render-target surface onto which a 3D volume projects.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of this object.

parameters.parameter: A bounding box that defines the location and size of the viewport in a render target.

constructor.summary: Creates an instance of this object.

parameters.parameter: The x coordinate of the upper-left corner of the viewport in pixels.
The y coordinate of the upper-left corner of the viewport in pixels.
The width of the viewport in pixels.
The height of the viewport in pixels.

property.name: AspectRatio
property.summary: Gets the aspect ratio used by the viewport

property.name: Bounds
property.summary: Gets the size of this resource.

property.name: Height
property.summary: Gets or sets the height dimension of the viewport on the render-target surface, in pixels.
property.remarks: Unless rendering is being done only to a subset of the surface, this member should be set to the height dimension of the render target surface.

property.name: MaxDepth
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum depth of the clip volume.
property.remarks: MaxDepth , together with MinDepth , specifies the range of depth values into which a scene is rendered. Most applications set this value to 1.0. Clipping is performed after the projection matrix is applied.

property.name: MinDepth
property.summary: Gets or sets the minimum depth of the clip volume.
property.remarks: MinDepth , together with MaxDepth , specifies the range of depth values into which a scene is rendered. Most applications set this value to 0.0. Clipping is performed after the projection matrix is applied.

property.name: TitleSafeArea
property.summary: Returns the title safe area of the current viewport.
property.remarks: On television sets, text should not be displayed at the outer edges of the screen because it may not be visible to the user. The title safe area is the part of the screen where text should be displayed. This property does not compare the current location of the viewport with the title safe area of the entire display—it reduces the title safe area of the viewport uniformly.

property.name: Width
property.summary: Gets or sets the width dimension of the viewport on the render-target surface, in pixels.
property.remarks: Unless rendering is being done only to a subset of the surface, this member should be set to the width dimension of the render-target surface.

property.name: X
property.summary: Gets or sets the pixel coordinate of the upper-left corner of the viewport on the render-target surface.
property.remarks: Unless rendering is being done only to a subset of the surface, this member can be set to 0.

property.name: Y
property.summary: Gets or sets the pixel coordinate of the upper-left corner of the viewport on the render-target surface.
property.remarks: Unless rendering is being done only to a subset of the surface, this member can be set to 0.

method.name: Project
method.summary: Projects a 3D vector from object space into screen space.

overload.summary: Projects a 3D vector from object space into screen space.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

method.name: Unproject
method.summary: Projects a vector from screen space into object space.

overload.summary: Projects a vector from screen space into object space.
